name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.4 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.4 fixes duplicate filtering so unresolved cards cannot leak into duplicate results, requires corroborating title evidence for provider-ID matches, and retains Needs ID, native multi-select, playback, Series/Season and metadata-management functionality.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.5 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.5 restores Jellyfin's native right-click and multi-select administration by keeping context-menu handling untouched and raising the native selection command bar above Velvet Antenna navigation, while retaining inline IDENTIFY, duplicate resolution badges and DELETE, native Series/Season functionality, subtitles and detail PLAY/CONTINUE.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.8 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Reliability-focused Antenna Flow release. v0.22.8 adds a single delegated interaction layer so VA navigation no longer depends on per-screen button listeners or hidden Jellyfin cards, resolves Movies/Series/Collections from the current Jellyfin User Views API, and performs bounded self-healing when Jellyfin re-renders a page without the expected VA surface. Collection Manager gains direct CHANGE POSTER and CHANGE BACKDROP uploads through Jellyfin's native uploadItemImage API. Video playback gains a permanent EXIT control that delegates to Jellyfin's own native headerBackButton so Jellyfin remains responsible for closing playback. Source-aware TMDb collection completeness, Add from Library, first-paint Home, Tonight, Velvet Lens, right-click administration and CC+ subtitle search remain included.
